english.title: Warehouse occupier / goods proprietor fail to pay excise duty
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[occupier of]_
(B)_[proprietor of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), stored at]_

a warehouse at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) refused to pay the amount of excise duty to which you had been assessed, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AMOUNT OF DUTY..), under section 94(3)(b) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979, the conditions as set out in section 94(4B) of the Act having been fulfilled and the goods stored in that warehouse having been found to be

(C)_[missing]_
(D)_[deficient]_

before being lawfully removed from the warehouse in accordance with a proper clearance
english.legislation: Contrary to section 94(4A) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
